description: Write a pandas ETL script for logistics_co that incrementally loads shipment status updates. The script should: (1) read the watermark (last processed updated_at, UTC) from a JSON state file, (2) read the source CSV extract and keep only rows with updated_at strictly greater than the watermark after converting updated_at to UTC, (3) convert weight_lb to weight_kg (divide by 2.20462, round to 2 decimals), (4) normalize status to lower case with whitespace trimmed, (5) upsert into the target Parquet dataset keyed on shipment_id, (6) advance the watermark to the maximum updated_at actually loaded. For the sample, the watermark is 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z.
edge_cases: s3 has a +02:00 offset and equals the watermark exactly once converted to UTC; it must be excluded
Comparison is strict (>): s2 at the watermark was loaded by the previous run
New watermark must be the max loaded updated_at (2025-06-01T13:30:00Z), not the script's run time
If no rows qualify, the watermark must remain unchanged and the target untouched
Watermark must be persisted only after the target write succeeds
common_failure_modes: FM2: Comparing ISO strings lexically or dropping offsets includes s3 and misorders s4
FM2: Setting the watermark to now() skips rows committed upstream with earlier timestamps
FM7: No check that the target write succeeded before advancing the watermark
